slug: 2025-11-17 Angola begins issuance of ID cards to newborns

systems.owner: Ministry of Health with UNICEF; the provincial delegation of Justice and Human Rights
systems.tiers: registration equipment in maternity wards, starting in Mbanza Kongo municipality and then the other 10 municipalities of Zaire province

note: Birth registration and ID issuance in maternity wards, run by national ministries; municipalities are named only as places. Nothing on a local government office's connection.
